name: Efficient Local kNN
definition: A drop-in O(N) local k-nearest neighbors module that exploits known multi-view grid structure to replace global brute-force search, reducing complexity from O(N^2) to O(N).
summary: Efficient Local kNN is an O(N) k-nearest neighbors algorithm for rendering that reduces complexity by constraining searches to spatially adjacent pixels, offering significant speedups with negligible quality loss.
